title: admitUploadRequest
responsibility: Rejects cross-origin, non-multipart or oversized upload headers before any body read, using each endpoint’s explicit limit.

inputs.name: admitUploadRequest.request
inputs.description: Required incoming HTTP request. Only Origin, Content-Type and Content-Length headers are inspected; the body is never read.

inputs.name: admitUploadRequest.targetOrigin
inputs.description: Required target origin string, compared exactly with the Origin header.

inputs.name: admitUploadRequest.limit
inputs.description: Required media-specific byte limit. Content-Length is converted with Number, preserving missing, invalid and negative-header behavior.

outputs.name: admitUploadRequest
outputs.description: Null admits body parsing; otherwise a JSON error response: 403 for origin, 415 for multipart content type, then 413 for excessive Content-Length, in that order.
